title: Q-IMPROVE-SIGNAL-suggestions: suggestions signal is unmeasured
body:

**Trigger:** improve --run
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation improve --probe signal:suggestions
**Prediction:** signal_suggestions_ok == 1 within 72 h
**Status:** closed

ops/reach/metrics.jsonl is unmeasured. A signal nobody reads is a blind spot, not a quiet week. Restore the producer or give it a second route.

**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation improve --probe signal:suggestions

**Disposition:** shelved (executor-failed, 2026-11-25T19:32:51Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** the executor failed 3 consecutive runs on this item; last reason: RuntimeError: checks failed after 3 attempts: the reply was not valid JSON with a files list: RuntimeError: every code agent rung failed: workers-ai-glm: HTTPError: HTTP Error 401: Unauthorized | github-models-gpt: RuntimeError: non-JSON re.
